visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with brown hair in a ponytail wearing a bright orange turtleneck speaks directly to the camera in a brightly lit indoor room. (2) A young boy with glasses in a brownish shirt sits at a grand piano, playing it with focus. (3) The woman sits next to the boy at the piano, putting her arm around his shoulder as they converse; variety text captions appear around them. (4) The boy plays several emphatic notes on the piano while the woman watches and smiles. (5) Close-up of the boy's face followed by both of them cheering with raised arms. (6) They are inside a bright retail store with shelves of products; the woman raises her arms excitedly. (7) Close-up shots of various Ultraman-themed prizes like keychains and magnets on a display board. (8) The woman shows five 100-dollar bills to the camera in the store. (9) The boy reaches into a lottery box and draws multiple cards; the woman and boy react with exaggerated facial expressions of joy as prizes are revealed. (10) Clean product shots of an ID card holder and a portable power bank are shown. (11) The boy wears a full-head Ultraman mask and poses while the woman laughs next to him. (12) They stand together in the store, speaking to the camera and making thumbs-up gestures as promotional text overlays the screen.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A woman in her 30s with light brown hair, wearing a bright orange turtleneck. A young boy around 8-10 years old with glasses, wearing a rust-colored long-sleeve shirt.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: Initially a bright indoor home setting with a grand piano. Later, the interior of a COSMED retail store with pharmacy shelves, promotional posters, and product displays.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female voice speaks with a friendly, casual tone in a studio-quiet environment. (2) Sound of a piano playing a melodic tune with moderate tempo. (3) Female and child male voices interact with a cheerful, high-arousal tone; light, bouncy background music with a synth texture begins. (4) Several loud, percussive piano chords ring out with a dramatic flair. (5) High-pitched cheering and laughter, followed by a "shing" sound effect and the start of a high-energy pop BGM with a strong beat (~128 BPM). (6) Both voices shout and talk excitedly with high arousal; ambient store chatter and light mechanical hum are audible. (7) Narrative female voice over upbeat pop music; percussive beat is prominent. (8) Rapid-fire dialogue with whoosh and ding SFX accompanying transitions. (9) Extremely energetic vocal delivery with frequent laughter; multiple ding and pop sound effects occur as lottery cards are drawn; the pop BGM remains continuous. (10) Clear narrative voice describing products over the steady pop beat. (11) Loud laughter and high-pitched vocalizations of excitement. (12) Concluding professional yet enthusiastic narration; ends with a final musical stinger.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Challenge -> Reward/Event -> Promotion -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a mother rewarding her son for his diligent piano practice by taking him to a COSMED store to participate in an Ultraman-themed lottery event. It aims to showcase the event's prizes (magnets, headgear, power banks) and promote the activity to other parents.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand logos (COSMED), clear product demonstrations of the lottery prizes, and a concluding call to visit the stores for the specific event starting on Feb 10.

high_inference.freeDescribe: High-production value social media vlog with dense variety-show style editing, aimed at a family audience in Taiwan.
